opportunity.title: First Bouldering Session
opportunity.activity: An intro bouldering session on the beginner wall, taking turns spotting and cheering each other on.
opportunity.collaborationTask: As a team, pick one beginner route and work out the moves together until everyone has tried it.
opportunity.publicRationale: This quest draws on interests members listed, like climbing, fits a time when enough members are free, and happens at an approved public venue. It is an easy way for new people to start talking.
